description: A village hosts a banquet and provides bike and car transportation for everyone. A bike can take 3 people while a car can take 5 people. Since cars are more expensive, at most 40% of the vehicles can be cars. If the village needs to transport at least 500 people, how many of each vehicle should be used to minimize the total number of bikes needed?

BikeCapacity.definition: Number of people each bike can transport

CarCapacity.definition: Number of people each car can transport

MaxCarPercentage.definition: Maximum percentage of vehicles that can be cars

NumberOfPeople.definition: Total number of people to transport

objective.description: "Minimize the total number of bikes used to transport at least 500 people"

constraints.description: NumberOfBikes and NumberOfCars must be non-negative integers

NumberOfBikes.definition: Number of bikes used for transportation

NumberOfCars.definition: Number of cars used for transportation
